item.vsfluidlink.hose_connector.tooltip:
Makes fluid transport between ships easier. 
Right-click with a wrench to set a connection point, 
then right-click another connector to link.
item.vsfluidlink.magnet_hose_connector.t:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
item.vsfluidlink.item_hose_connector.too:
Makes item transport between ships easier. 
Right-click with a wrench to set a connection point, 
then right-click another connector to link. 
Requires rotational power (32+ RPM) to operate.
item.vsfluidlink.item_magnet_hose_connec:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal. 
Requires rotational power (32+ RPM) to operate.
item.vsfluidlink.electric_wire_connector:
Makes energy (FE) transport between ships easier. 
Right-click with a wrench to set a connection point, 
then right-click another connector to link.
item.vsfluidlink.electric_magnet_wire_co:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
item.vsfluidlink.chain_connector.tooltip:
Makes rotational power transport between ships easier. 
Right-click with a wrench to set a connection point, 
then right-click another connector to link.
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
vsfluidlink.message.world_to_world_restr: Connection between world blocks is restricted by config.
vsfluidlink.message.intra_ship_restricte: Connection within the same ship is restricted by config.
